first_words: A stick swung down and smashed
right into the toucan's upper beak
every time it tried to eat
compared it to another toucan's beak
rebuild the missing half on a computer
But the new beak couldn't be too heavy
So they made it full-size, but almost hollow
rescuers lined it up with the broken stump
glued the base into place, and fixed the rest with a pin
the toucan could pick up fruit again
